entries.title: Search is now fast, paginated, and full-width
bullets: Speed fixed. The search was in an iframe that re-booted the entire app (all providers) every time — that was the 20-30s. It now mounts the real search page directly in the conversation, reusing the already-running app, so it renders in ~1-2s like the normal page.
Pagination is back. Because the page renders in the natural flow (not a fixed frame), its own pagination shows at the bottom of the results, and there's no scroll-within-scroll.
Full width. The working session and every inline now max out the screen with responsive margins (desktop → tablet → mobile). No more tablet-like dead space.
Only the latest search stays live; earlier searches collapse to a one-line recap with a Show live results button.
